summary: Iteration 95 — Quick Add REFINEMENTS retest (dealer reconciliation, Catalog chooser, bundle flow, bundle auto-check). Backend: 6/6 PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration95_qa_refinements.py — GET /api/community/profile/MILWAUKEE|276720 surfaces dealer='Home Depot' count=3 with consensus (>=2); GET /api/community/profile/SNAPON|SOEX710 surfaces is_bundle=true + dealer='Snap-on Truck' count=3; /api/community/lookup returns is_bundle=true for SOEX710 and false for 2767-20 so qa-bundle can auto-check; POST /api/tools with is_bundle=true persists round-trip; dealer CRUD for the 'Create' path works. Frontend UI (headless Chromium via token-inject bypass since /login stalls in preview): (a) qa-dealer verified as a PICKER (TouchableOpacity div, no input/textarea child) that opens a modal listing existing dealers via qa-dealer-opt-* + accepts new via qa-new-dealer-input/qa-add-dealer — CONFIRMED. (b) BottomBar Catalog chooser opens on tab-catalog tap and shows BOTH 'tab-catalog-community catalog' + 'tab-catalog-dealer catalogs'; tapping Community Catalog navigates to /community; tapping Dealer Catalogs does NOT navigate and the 'COMING SOON' badge/text is visible in the DOM — CONFIRMED. (c) Selecting the SOEX710 match auto-checks qa-bundle (Ionicons glyph f21a = 'checkbox' vs f593 = 'square-outline' for 2767-20) — CONFIRMED. (d) imp-* import checkboxes populate for both models. WEB-ONLY CAVEAT: React Native's Alert.alert (multi-button) does NOT render as a browser dialog on react-native-web in this build — so the 'Dealer from community' reconciliation Alert (pick mine / Create X / Skip) and the 'Coming soon' Alert do NOT visibly fire in the web preview (Playwright dialog event never triggers; no in-app modal replacement). This is a react-native-web limitation, not a code bug — the same code paths work on native iOS/Android. Backend consensus data is correct and the code branches (reconcileDealer, Alert on comingSoon) are wired; only the Alert UI is silent on web.
